description: I'm Hammad Abdullah, Bioinformatics student and Machine Learning Engineer interested in AI, healthcare, and space technology. I aim to build software that monitors astronauts' vital signs, detects unusual patterns, and predicts health risks during space missions. Skills include Python, Machine Learning, and Data Science. I'm seeking teammates skilled in biomedical engineering, software development, UI/UX, and aerospace engineering. Let's make space exploration safer through innovation!
